operations.details: Verified official EA National LIDAR Programme dataset.
National programme coverage separated into survey blocks.
Repeat survey phases retained as distinct acquisition lineage.
National coverage not promoted to one uniform acquisition date.
Verified official EA DSM Time Stamped Tiles dataset.
Survey date, resolution, transformation and geoid required for tile use.
Timestamped DSM surface objects rejected as bare-earth terrain.
Vertical RMSE kept independent from product resolution.
Both EA URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No unmatched phase or DSM surface value substituted for parcel terrain result.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
